question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
WITH qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.country_id = 52790
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
  GROUP BY c.cust_city
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND (SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) - 
          SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END)) / 
          NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END), 0) >= 0.20
),
product_city_quarter_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id,
         c.cust_city,
         t.calendar_quarter_id,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) as city_quarter_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.country_id = 52790
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_total_sales AS (
  SELECT prod_id,
         calendar_quarter_id,
         SUM(city_quarter_sales) as total_sales
  FROM product_city_quarter_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_quarter_id
),
total_sales_all AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_sales) as grand_total
  FROM product_total_sales
  WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1776
),
product_share AS (
  SELECT pts.prod_id,
         pts.calendar_quarter_id,
         pts.total_sales,
         (pts.total_sales * 1.0 / tsa.grand_total) as share
  FROM product_total_sales pts
  JOIN total_sales_all tsa ON 1=1
  WHERE pts.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
),
share_change AS (
  SELECT prod_id,
         calendar_quarter_id,
         share,
         LAG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY prod_id ORDER BY calendar_quarter_id) as prev_share,
         share - LAG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY prod_id ORDER BY calendar_quarter_id) as share_change_pp
  FROM product_share
  WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1776
)
SELECT * FROM share_change ORDER BY share_change_pp ASC
